cause: The standalone consumer has its own Cargo workspace. With CARGO_TARGET_DIR unset in CI, Cargo writes contracts/native-probes/target; the root-anchored /target/ ignore does not exclude it. Generated artifacts enter Git-visible source inventory and exhaust its byte budget.
methods: Credential-free private receipt check executed read-only in the running CI workspace.
File names/sizes acquired using the same cleaned Git environment and source exclusion rules.
Virtual filtering and source hashing changed no CI worktree file, environment or receipt.
limits: The run10 job is not repaired or made passing by operator cleanup. A reviewed source correction and a new full CI run are required.
Run9 used the same anchored ignore and consumer build path; its original captured exception remains unavailable. The concrete cause is directly demonstrated in run10.
